one_line_description: An instant messaging and VoIP social platform.
auth_methods_evidence: The Composio registry lists OAuth2 as an authentication scheme for Discord.
self_serve_evidence: The Discord Developer Platform provides a self-serve environment for developers to build bots and integrations without requiring sales contact.
buildability_rationale: Discord offers a free self-serve platform with good documentation, OAuth2 authentication, and a substantial API with 27 tools in Composio.
agent_notes: Discord provides a comprehensive developer platform with OAuth2 authentication and a variety of API endpoints for building bots and integrations.
